title: Who Took the Bins Out?

pre.en: Who is clapping in the front row at the end?
pre.zh: 最后坐在第一排鼓掌的是谁？

intro: 一篇演讲稿：Rota 上线派对上，产品经理 Hannah 讲这个 App 是怎么来的，最后现场演示。演讲开头打招呼、先预告要讲什么，结尾不总结。读的时候留意形式主语 it：It took … to …、It's easy to …、It's worth …，把很长的主语挪到句子后面。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone, and thanks for coming out on a Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 各位晚上好，谢谢大家星期四晚上还专门跑一趟。

sentences.en: I'll keep this to a five-minute talk.
sentences.zh: 我就讲五分钟。

sentences.en: First, how Rota began, then what we learned, and then a live demo.
sentences.zh: 先讲 Rota 是怎么开始的，再讲我们学到了什么，最后现场演示一下。

sentences.en: It all started when my three flatmates and I got sick of arguing about the bins.
sentences.zh: 一切要从我和三个室友为倒垃圾吵烦了说起。

sentences.en: We shared a four-bedroom flat in Hackney.
sentences.zh: 我们在 Hackney 合租一套四居室。

sentences.en: Every Wednesday morning, the bins were still in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 每个星期三早上，垃圾桶都还在厨房里。

sentences.en: So we put a list on the fridge to keep things fair.
sentences.zh: 所以为了公平，我们在冰箱上贴了一张值日表。

sentences.en: We couldn't get over how quickly it disappeared under pizza menus.
sentences.zh: 没想到它那么快就被一堆披萨菜单盖住了。

sentences.en: Then we tried to make do with a group chat, which was even worse.
sentences.zh: 后来我们只好凑合着用群聊，结果更糟。

sentences.en: It took us fourteen months and two hundred interviews to get the app off the ground.
sentences.zh: 我们花了十四个月、做了两百次访谈，才让这个 App 做起来。

sentences.en: I nearly dropped out of the whole project twice.
sentences.zh: 我两次差点就不干了。

sentences.en: But it was all for the best, because the second time, I met Chen.
sentences.zh: 不过结果反倒是好事，因为第二次想放弃的时候，我认识了小陈。

sentences.en: He set up our first test version in a weekend, and Arjun built the server from Bangalore.
sentences.zh: 他一个周末就搭好了第一个测试版，Arjun 在班加罗尔把服务器做了出来。

sentences.en: Honestly, it's easy to build features.
sentences.zh: 说实话，做功能很容易。

sentences.en: It's much harder to make life easier for four tired people in a kitchen.
sentences.zh: 要让厨房里四个累坏了的人日子好过一点，就难多了。

sentences.en: And it's worth remembering that most people can do without another app.
sentences.zh: 还有一点得记住：大多数人不多装一个 App，日子也照样过。

sentences.en: By the way, we got a good deal on this room, so please eat all the sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这个场地我们租得很便宜，所以请把三明治都吃完。

sentences.en: Thank you to our investors and to everyone who answered our questions.
sentences.zh: 感谢我们的投资人，也感谢每一位回答过我们问题的人。

sentences.en: And last but not least, thank you to Chen and Arjun, who actually built it.
sentences.zh: 最后还要特别感谢真正把它做出来的小陈和 Arjun。

sentences.en: Right, please take a look at the big screen for the live demo.
sentences.zh: 好，请大家看大屏幕，我们现场演示。

sentences.en: This is my real flat, with real chores, right now.
sentences.zh: 这是我家真实的公寓，真实的家务，就是此时此刻。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: A notification's just come up.
sentences.zh: 刚弹出来一条通知。

sentences.en: "Hannah, it's your turn to take the bins out."
sentences.zh: 「Hannah，该你倒垃圾了。」

sentences.en: Yes, Freya, I can hear you clapping in the front row.
sentences.zh: 是的，Freya，我听见你在第一排鼓掌了。

sentences.en: I'll do them tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚就倒。

sentences.en: Probably.
sentences.zh: 大概吧。

cards.zh: 一切要从……说起；事情是从……开始的
cards.note: used to begin telling the story of how something began
cards.tip: 讲故事、演讲开头的常用说法，when 后面用一般过去时。
cards.example: It all started when my sister gave me an old camera.

cards.note: to be bored with or annoyed by something because it has happened too often
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing；语气比 be tired of 更重，口语常说 sick and tired of。
cards.example: I'm sick of eating sandwiches for lunch every day.

cards.note: 英式说 bin，美式说 trash can；take the bins out 是把垃圾桶推到路边等收。
That's not fair!（不公平！）名词 fairness。

cards.zh: （惊讶得）想不通；还没回过神来
cards.note: to be very surprised by something and keep thinking about it
外卖单页也叫 menu；读 /ˈmenjuː/。
to manage with something that is not as good as you want, because there is nothing better
做产品时的用户访谈叫 user interviews；也是「面试」。

cards.zh: 让（计划、项目）启动起来、做成
cards.note: to make a plan or a project start and begin to succeed
cards.tip: 常说新公司、新项目、新产品；也可以说 sth gets off the ground（启动了）。
cards.example: It took us a year to get the café off the ground.

cards.note: to leave a school, university or course before you have finished it
cards.tip: 第 79 课说的是退学；这里是退出一个项目。不说 drop out from。
cards.example: Two runners dropped out of the race because of the heat.

cards.zh: （结果）是最好的安排；塞翁失马
cards.note: if something is for the best, it seems bad now but will have a good result later
cards.tip: 常加 all：It's all for the best；多用来安慰别人或自己。
cards.example: Missing that flight was for the best — I met my wife at the airport.

cards.note: to get a machine or a piece of equipment ready so that it can be used
cards.tip: 第 81 课是设置平板；这里是搭建一个测试版。过去式、过去分词都是 set up。
cards.example: We set up a shared calendar for the whole team.

cards.note: 最新版是 the latest version；测试版 test / beta version。
to make things less difficult for someone
cards.tip: 为谁轻松用 for sb；也可以说 make sb's life easier。反过来是 make life difficult for sb。
cards.example: A dishwasher would make life easier for all of us.

cards.zh: 没有（某物）也行；将就着不用
cards.note: to manage without having something
to buy something at a good price
used when you mention the last person or thing in a list, to say they are just as important as the others
cards.tip: 致谢、介绍人时放在最后一项前面；书面报告里少用，演讲、颁奖很常见。
cards.example: Last but not least, thanks to my parents for all their help.

cards.note: to look at something, often quickly
cards.tip: 比 look at 客气、随意；也常说 have a look at（英式）。
cards.example: Can you take a look at my report before I send it?

cards.note: clapping 要双写 p；掌声也说 applause。
读 /rəʊ/；同形的 row 读 /raʊ/ 时是「吵架」。
